description: One bearing rotates the canopy, horses and platform together; the base is fixed.
units: metres, kilograms, seconds; Z-up in MJCF; radians for joint/control angles
controller: Bounded virtual actuators, scripted demonstration, not a learned policy.
limitations: Horses do not move independently. Appearance repairs are attached to the existing rotor; original collision proxies and inferred mass/inertia are retained.
Physical dimensions, masses, friction and drive parameters are editable estimates. Collision checks concern simplified proxies.
MuJoCo viewer shading differs from the source GLB PBR and the lit Overview video.
